answer: Make refusal pay. Each epoch the ledger plants hidden traps: real tasks whose stated figures were mutated to contradict. Only recomputation finds them. Answering costs twenty times base reward; abstaining and naming the bad figure pays half. The set is beacon-committed after cutoff. Keys fed by one model fail in unison, so one error slashes the cluster: solvency needs a thousand independent checkers. Reused text turns one mistake into a flood, a river drowning every field on a ditch. Farms reach a zenith only by buying real per-item work; slashed bonds fill a vault paying abstention.
